summary: Accelerate session hosts inspection via native proc scan

delivery.outcome: Accelerate session hosts discovery and process ancestry inspection via native proc scanning in Rust with multi-reading and bounded metadata capture, preserving exact Python parity and fallback.
nonGoals: No external C library dependencies or system package additions
No changes to public CLI interface or JSON diagnostic schema contracts

architecture.decision: Implement native --session-hosts subcommand in snapshot.rs using safe nonblocking reads, UID fencing, and ancestry tree reconstruction, while retaining 100% Python fallback in diagnostics.session_hosts.
architecture.rollback: Revert commit on main; retain previous diagnostics release.

validation.evidence: Native session hosts inspection matches Python fallback across PID/UID fencing, process names, executable resolution, cmdline filtering, and ancestor stability.
Native proc scan safely handles unstable processes, non-decimal directories, and missing/inaccessible proc nodes.
All tests pass without regression; governance clean; publication via OneDev and independent Validator.
